svg.title: Figure 5. Brain and nerve cord
svg.desc: Figure 5. Slope chart of flow-capacity AUC for each removal order in the brain-dominant subgraph (8,123 types) and the nerve cord-dominant subgraph (3,628 types); lower is more fragile. Brain: sensory-motor betweenness 0.151, weighted out-degree 0.257, weighted in-degree 0.504, betweenness 0.544, pagerank 0.664, random 0.572. Nerve cord: sensory-motor betweenness 0.363, weighted out-degree 0.276, weighted in-degree 0.228, betweenness 0.477, pagerank 0.251, random 0.579. Under random removal they do not differ significantly (Welch t = -1.54, p = 0.13), but the most damaging order changes.

svg.text: The same six orders in the brain and in the nerve cord
